problem: pack masks stream lengths with & 0xFFFF instead of raising, so inputs of 0x40000 bytes or more encode successfully but decode to wrong bytes with no error.
unpack dropped the block-length and jump-table-sum checks, so truncated or corrupt blocks decode silently to short or wrong streams.
pack no longer checks for exactly 4 streams, so it emits malformed blocks for other counts, and it is now inconsistent with join, which still validates.
split lost its MIN_SPLIT_SIZE guard, so inputs under 4 bytes no longer raise and yield three empty streams, an undocumented contract change.
unpack hardcodes 6 instead of TABLE_SIZE, and TABLE_SIZE, MAX_TABLE_LENGTH and MIN_SPLIT_SIZE are now unused.
